text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got time back. Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10, so CRM updates actually happened the same day.

2. Consistency beat brilliance. Summaries weren't perfect, but every call had one. Managers finally saw patterns in objections.

3. Trust takes setup. Customers asked about recording, so we added a clear opt-in line to every intro.

4. Adoption followed usefulness. Reps who saw follow-up emails drafted for them became advocates fast.

The biggest lesson: don't measure the tool by transcripts. Measure it by what reps do with the hours they save: more customer conversations, or just more admin?

What would you track in your pilot?
